Rationale.RP1_ImplementationReconstructability: The experiment was fully reconstructable from plan.md and CodeWalkthrough.md. The methodology (OV matrix summation, hidden state extraction, parallelogram arithmetic evaluation) was clearly documented with specified parameters (k=80, layers, head orderings). Minor ambiguities in nnsight API usage were resolved via documentation.
Rationale.RP2_EnvironmentReproducibility: All dependencies (nnsight, transformers, torch) installed successfully. Llama-2-7b-hf model accessible via HuggingFace. Pre-computed causal scores and original results available in cache directories. GPU memory constraints required bfloat16 precision but did not affect accuracy.
Rationale.RP3_DeterminismAndStability: Results highly stable with 60 comparisons showing mean absolute difference of 0.24% and max difference of 1.42%. All differences within 2% tolerance. No random components in the pipeline - OV extraction, forward pass, and cosine similarity are all deterministic operations.
Rationale.RP4_DemoPresentation: NA - Replication was based on full experiment implementation from plan and code walkthrough, not a demo script. The repository contains complete experiment code rather than a demo-only setup.
